configurePresets.name: _base
configurePresets.description: Common settings for every cutils preset: out-of-source build under build/<preset-name>, compile_commands.json emitted for clangd, tests enabled. The generator is intentionally left unset so CMake uses its platform default (Unix Makefiles on Linux); both Make and Ninja emit compile_commands.json. Set a generator in CMakeUserPresets.json to override.

configurePresets.name: _ci
configurePresets.description: Verification overlay: turns CUTILS_WERROR on so -Wall/-Wextra become build failures (and -Wl,--fatal-warnings escalates linker diagnostics) on cutils' own targets only. Third-party code (embunit, FreeRTOS kernel) is unaffected. Mixed into each ci-* preset below; never inherited on its own. Local development deliberately stays warnings-only -- see issue #38.

configurePresets.name: pthread-debug
configurePresets.description: Host pthread flavor, Debug. Runs under ctest on a hosted libc + pthreads system.

configurePresets.name: pthread-rt-debug
configurePresets.description: Host pthread flavor with a real-time scheduling policy (SCHED_RR), Debug. Exposes the real 1..99 priority range so task_create_params_t::priority is honored via PTHREAD_EXPLICIT_SCHED — but on Linux this requires CAP_SYS_NICE (run as root, or grant the capability). Intended for the embedded-Linux (e.g. PREEMPT_RT) production target, not unprivileged host dev/CI; ctest under this preset will EPERM/segfault without privilege.

configurePresets.name: c11-debug
configurePresets.description: Host C11-threads flavor, Debug. Calls into pthread underneath.

configurePresets.name: freertos-debug
configurePresets.description: FreeRTOS/M7 cross-build for the QEMU mps2-an500 (Cortex-M7) per-suite embtest_<suite> runners, Debug. Requires the arm-none-eabi-* bare-metal toolchain and qemu-system-arm on PATH (see cmake/arm-none-eabi.cmake). Fetches FreeRTOS-Kernel via FetchContent (CUTILS_FREERTOS_SOURCE=fetch).

configurePresets.name: ci-pthread-debug
configurePresets.description: Strict host pthread build, Debug. Same as pthread-debug with warnings as errors.

configurePresets.name: ci-pthread-release
configurePresets.description: Strict host pthread build, Release. Optimization enables GCC's data-flow-dependent analyses (-Warray-bounds, -Wmaybe-uninitialized, -Wstrict-aliasing), which do not fire at -O0 -- so this preset catches a class of warnings the Debug presets structurally cannot.

configurePresets.name: ci-pthread-rt-debug
configurePresets.description: Strict host pthread build with SCHED_RR, Debug. Build-only: compiles the CUTILS_PTHREAD_SCHED_POLICY=SCHED_RR branches that the SCHED_OTHER presets never touch. There is deliberately no matching test preset -- running these tests needs CAP_SYS_NICE and will EPERM unprivileged.

configurePresets.name: ci-c11-release
configurePresets.description: Strict host C11-threads build, Release. See ci-pthread-release for why the Release variants matter.

configurePresets.name: ci-freertos-debug
configurePresets.description: Strict FreeRTOS/M7 cross-build, Debug. Requires arm-none-eabi-* and qemu-system-arm on PATH.

testPresets.name: pthread-rt-debug
testPresets.description: Real-time (SCHED_RR) pthread tests. Requires CAP_SYS_NICE; will EPERM/segfault unprivileged.
